historical_quote_rule: superseded document status only; never historical eligibility/fee/window sections

metric_definitions.citation_correctness: Emitted citations whose (source, section) is in the supplied expected label set, divided by all emitted citations. Gold-label relevance proxy, not semantic entailment or exhaustive answer correctness.
metric_definitions.citation_verbatim_support: Emitted quotes found verbatim after whitespace normalization in their retrieved source, divided by all emitted quotes. Does not prove relevance or policy sufficiency.
metric_definitions.abstention_accuracy: Final answer/abstain behavior equal to supplied expected_behavior, divided by all questions; blocked model outputs count as abstention.
metric_definitions.answerable_coverage: Answerable questions receiving an answer, divided by all answerable questions. Correctness is not implied.

freeze: Development-only iteration from explanation-v2. Original heldout is already observed and must only be reported as a regression diagnostic. New supplementary heldout is run only after protocol freeze; authored by the implementer, not blind/independent.
generation_states: answer requires 1-4 citations; abstain requires zero, enforced by JSON oneOf grammar and independently by server validation
